conclusions.fact: Normal control takes --runtime-coordinator-config plus --trial-readonly-model-vault-dir, --trial-readonly-credential-ref and --trial-readonly-provider; RESEARCHOS_DATA_DIR selects isolated root. JSON fills missing data_root/API URL, host supplies workspace/configuration/model credential/run tool/schema, then NewRuntimeCoordinatorWithLease and Serve. Discovery writes url,pid,data_dir,host_instance_id.

Private JSON fields: data_root, api_url, scheduler_token, routes[{project_id,runtime_id,executor_id,executor_token,command_id,executable,bundle_file}], providers[{id,project_id,runtime_id,purpose,capability,credential_revision,endpoint,bearer_token,upper_bound,measurement_mode,source_id,source_token,browser_act_path,browser_id,model_config,credential_ref}]. Host callback fields json:- cannot be supplied in JSON. Real LIVE example has separate MODEL routes for runtime_qualification and mu_turn, plus TOOL for mu_turn.

CLI init <workspace> uses real Host discovery, local session/native Owner bootstrap, NATIVE_WORKSPACE_CHOOSE_REQUEST requested_path/requested_access=READ_WRITE, workspace.register selection_ref/display_name/requested_access, then project.bootstrap authorized_workspace_ref/display_name. CLI goal <objective> --draft sends goal.start objective, contract_artifact_ids, start_as_draft=true. CLI discovery/config may be isolated through RESEARCHOS_CLI_DISCOVERY and RESEARCHOS_CLI_CONFIG.

RegisterRuntimeQualificationPlan and BeginRuntimeQualification are trusted local Service methods requiring an authenticated current project OWNER token and project grant. Begin consumes the private plan and returns Run plus lease token; helper must issue a project-granted EXECUTOR token for bound route and SCHEDULER token for coordinator. RunAdmitted executes one pre-admitted Run; ordinary Serve Scan excludes runtime_qualification tasks. No HTTP/native qualification-start call appeared in checked API/Host source.

Reusable W14 setup creates accepted Requirement, RuntimeRegistration, sealed Artifact profile, separate active qualification Goal, DRAFT runtime_qualification Task with profile input and context bundle, then registers private plan. After genuine SETTLED Run/result Artifact it posts VERIFIER /acceptances (DETERMINISTIC_SERVICE), qualifies /runtimes/{id}/qualify with actual LOG Artifact and grants mu_turn purpose with bounded expiry. These downstream HTTP bodies are in qualify.go.

Current Main normal Host has no trusted external trigger for plan registration/Begin/RunAdmitted; simply launching control with JSON or posting a qualification Task cannot run qualification. A reviewed trusted local helper/Host action is needed, or port of existing live_setup phase, while maintaining one data-root lease and a single Root-owned 300s Job. The W14 test helper is fixed to older W14 candidate, DeepSeek config and 10-minute setup context, so it cannot be run unchanged as this trial.
